args.title: Re-enable the export button after a failed export
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Change the ExportButton's state management to allow re-exports after a failed export.

label: bug
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The ExportButton component's busy state prevents re-exports after a failure. This change will allow the button to be re-enabled.
